assay: bulk RNA-seq, gastrocnemius, Novogene: Hisat2 v2.0.5 + featureCounts v1.5.0-p3, HiSeq 4000 (S2.3.p1)
sample_inclusion: male C57BL/6 mice, 12 weeks HFD (45% fat), 5 groups: HFD-C sedentary, HFD-25%, HFD-50%, HFD-75%, HFD-U wheel running; n = 6 per group with RQN > 6.3 (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1, FIG3)
sample_exclusion: not_reported within HFD groups; GEO additionally deposits 6 NFD-C (normal-fat sedentary, 'CS_*') samples that the paper never analyses
primary_estimand: Effect of voluntary wheel running at each defined distance (25/50/75/100% of unrestricted) vs sedentary, all on HFD, on the gastrocnemius transcriptome: four exercise-group vs HFD-C contrasts (FIG2a, S3.p1).
other_analyses_not_reproduced: 'HFD-C vs all exercise groups combined' = 1094 DEGs (S3.p1): pools four distinct levels; not run (skill: never pool levels)
DRomics dose-response (S3.p4): no executor; not reproduced
KEGG ORA (clusterProfiler) of up/down lists (S3.p6, FIG6-7)

blocking_or_covariance.reason: one muscle sample per mouse, independent groups

matrix_scale: featureCounts raw read counts (S2.3.p1; GEO data_processing)
paper_method: DESeq2 (Novogene; DESeq2 1.20.0 per GEO), per comparison vs HFD-C; model details not reported

paper_threshold.note: S2.3.p1 adds 'raw count average >= 25' for the enrichment gene list only; Fig 3 / S3.p3 report a second, stricter list at DESeq2 FDR <= 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 1 (25/78/15/16 genes); that rule is computed as a labelled secondary count.

reported_unique_genes_venn.note: 9729 'overlapping' in Venn exceeds every per-group DEG count - internally inconsistent

enrichment.method: KEGG ORA (clusterProfiler) on up- and down-regulated lists, p <= 0.05 & raw count avg >= 25
